name: Yext
description: Yext is a digital presence platform for managing business entities, listings, reviews, search experiences, analytics, pages, and related content across publishers.
agentUseSummary: Yext cannot yet be connected through Relay. Yext supports confidential OAuth, but API authority is configured out-of-band through App Directory permissions rather than requested as consent scopes, and the public guide does not establish Relay's exact distributable permission, token-lifetime, refresh, or revocation contract without prohibited provider-console work.

blocked.label: Connect a Yext account
blocked.description: Relay cannot expose Connect until its App Directory permission and distribution contract is inspected and approved.

blocked.label: Infer provider permissions
blocked.description: Endpoint documentation and account API keys do not prove the permission bundle assigned to a distributed OAuth app.

blocked.label: Expose raw Yext APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary Management, Content Delivery, Search, Events, Streams, Connectors, webhook, and versioned endpoint access is not permitted.

blocked.label: Access Yext data
blocked.description: Accounts, entities, listings, reviews, comments, invitations, workflows, analytics, publishers, pages, search, social, connectors, and every read or write remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Yext action can be enabled before provider-console permission and lifecycle acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: No Yext wrappers are mounted before the OAuth app's exact provider permissions are accepted.
No Yext wrappers are mounted before the OAuth app's exact provider permissions are accepted.

providerSetup.blocker: Yext OAuth omits runtime scopes and assigns authority through App Directory Permissions and Endpoints configuration. This worker cannot open the provider console to establish the exact review-management or broader V1 permission identifiers, distribution eligibility, token lifetime, reconnect behavior, or revocation route.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should create or inspect a Yext App Directory app, select the minimum useful permission bundle, record every configured endpoint permission and redirect domain, confirm distribution/review requirements plus token expiry and revocation behavior, and return that frozen contract before connector implementation or Connect visibility.

evidence.supports: Yext documents confidential authorization-code OAuth, exact redirect validation, server-side client secret exchange, state, app-specific account identity, and permissions configured in the App Directory rather than requested during OAuth.
Yext documents versioned Management APIs, US/EU partitions, secret API-key authentication, and broad entity, listings, analytics, and reviews surfaces.
Yext publishes review list/get/create/update, response generation, comment management, and label operations with account permissions and plan/publisher constraints.
Yext's June 2026 changelog ends V1 support and adds review-workflow APIs, reinforcing the need for a pinned V2 version and explicit reviewed operation set.
